shots.subject_action_outcome: A quiet view looks down across the low lake basin and pale exposed shore, isolated from the cave landscape far away. → The separate Yucatán setting establishes that this second archive comes from a different country and a different environment.
shots.narrative_function: Separates the lake evidence geographically from the cave record.
shots.description: Moody oil-painted landscape in deep navy and amber, a single moonlit reflection as the warm source, thick canvas brushwork, low mist over the waterless margin, and fading black edges.

shots.subject_action_outcome: The finely banded lake sediment core is shown in close detail, its pale mineral-rich layers alternating with darker deposits under one amber oil lamp. → The core stands as a distinct archive that independently preserves the severe dry periods.
shots.narrative_function: Reveals the physical evidence from Hodell's lake record.
shots.description: Oil-painted close study with dense impasto marks along the sediment bands, deep navy surrounding shadow, one amber lamp source, drifting haze, canvas grain, and darkness swallowing the frame edges; no modern objects.

shots.scene: separate archive studies - divided evidence field
shots.subject_action_outcome: Two separated pools of amber light each isolate a different archive sample and its own handwritten field notes, with darkness preventing any shared workspace from forming between them. → The divided arrangement conveys that different research teams worked from different archives before arriving at the matching pattern.
shots.narrative_function: Underscores the independence of the two lines of evidence.
shots.description: Overhead oil-painted evidence still life in deep navy and amber, exactly two isolated warm pools treated as separate visual spaces, thick brushwork, canvas texture, misty darkness between the records, and no modern objects.

shots.scene: Lake Chichancanab field station - sample table
shots.subject_action_outcome: Place a lake-sediment core and a cave stalagmite sample side by side on a dark field table, each beside a different research instrument. → The two physical records are visibly distinct in origin and instrument.
shots.narrative_function: Make the independent sources and different methods legible without implying coordination between the researchers.
shots.description: Two separate climate archives occupy the frame: a lake core and a cave stalagmite sample, gathered with distinct instruments. Render as a moody oil-paint illustration with deep navy shadows, restrained amber light, and textured brushwork.

shots.scene: Lake Chichancanab field station - analysis table
shots.subject_action_outcome: Show the separate lake-core and stalagmite records bearing matching bands that mark the same severe dry interval. → Matching evidence appears across the two separate archives.
shots.narrative_function: Visualize the shared result returned by independent records.
shots.description: The two records remain apart on the table, but their corresponding dark bands align across the gap. A single warm lamp pools over the evidence while the surrounding work surface recedes into navy shadow.
